question: What is the name of the mascot for the 37th National Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Moga**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The mascot for the 37th National Games is **Moga**.
 
• The 37th National Games is a significant event showcasing various sports disciplines across India.
 
• Mascots play a crucial role in representing the spirit and culture of the hosting region.
 
• They often become a symbol of the games, promoting enthusiasm and unity among participants and spectators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Games of India are held every few years, featuring athletes from different states competing in various sports.
 
• The games aim to promote sportsmanship, identify new talent, and provide a platform for athletes to showcase their skills.
 
• Each edition of the National Games is organized by the Indian Olympic Association and hosted by a different state.
 
• The introduction of a mascot adds to the cultural and festive atmosphere of the games, making them more memorable.
